notes.title: FULL 2.0 Overhaul
notes.notes:
I created this project years ago when still in college over the course of an afternoon to learn how Steams publishing process has gone. Now that I have graduated and actually matured as a developer I wanted to come back and fix what was all around a very poor game. 

I've spent the last 1-2 months overhauling the entire project from the ground up using none of the OG code to recreate what was the intention for the original game but now functioning in a far better way as a game. Functionality its still a simple 2D Idle Clicker survival game but one that I largely don't feel embarrassed to have published under my name now that I am working on some more serious projects.

notes.title: Quality of life fixes and several bugs
notes.notes: I've decided to make a concerted effort to maintain this project in preparation for my next much larger release so I've fixed several bugs related to movement and fixed several interaction bugs
